name: Segment
description: Segment is Twilio's customer data platform (CDP) that collects, cleans, and activates first-party customer data across a company's tools, unifying it into a single customer profile.
best_for: Organizations seeking to unify fragmented customer data across systems, enable data-driven personalization at scale, and activate customer insights across marketing, sales, and service channels.
features: Connections: a customer data pipeline collecting first-party data and routing it to 550+ destinations
Unify: builds unified customer profiles from disparate data sources
Engage: builds advanced audiences and orchestrates real-time customer journeys
Integration with 750+ applications and destinations, including data warehouses
Combines customer data infrastructure with Twilio's communications capabilities

pricing.starting_price: No public price: the pricing page says to contact Twilio

tiers.name: Connections (Customer Data Pipeline)
tiers.notes: Priced by monthly tracked users; the page names a Business tier and says Connections starts with a free trial. No prices are published.

tiers.name: Customer Data Platform
tiers.notes: Custom volume pricing billed by invoice. No prices are published.

pros: Unified customer data pipeline (CDP) connecting a single tracking SDK to 550+ analytics, marketing, and warehouse destinations
Eliminates client-side tag bloat and reduces custom engineering maintenance across multiple tools
Real-time identity resolution, data hygiene validation (Protocols), and automated audience orchestration
cons: Steep pricing escalation based on Monthly Tracked Users (MTUs) as web and mobile traffic scales
Primarily a data routing infrastructure platform rather than an out-of-the-box visual analytics dashboard
Advanced data governance and reverse ETL features require enterprise Business plan contracts

alternatives.name: Amplitude
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform combining analytics, feedback, experimentation, and feature management.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams needing analytics with feature experimentation.

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining analytics, session replay, experiments, and AI-powered insights.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams wanting fast, data-driven product decisions.

alternatives.name: PostHog
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining product analytics, session replay, feature flags, and a customer data pipeline in one suite.
alternatives.best_for: Engineering-led teams wanting analytics, experimentation, and data pipelines in a single self-hostable platform.
